markets.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to DAL Cowboys D/ST in the Tampa Bay vs Dallas Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 8, 2026. If DAL Cowboys D/ST is active but never takes a snap, the market settles to the fair market price before game start. Once DAL Cowboys D/ST takes at least one snap, even if nullified by penalty, the market settles based on touchdowns scored.
